name: Widerspruch through the phone provider (all directories)

search.notes: Public subscriber directories in Germany publish entries only because the subscriber agreed with the phone provider under sections 104 and 105 TKG.

steps: The account holder contacts the phone provider using the service number on the contract or bill.
Ask to withdraw consent to publication in all public subscriber directories, or to limit the entry, and to object to reverse search (Inverssuche).
Check Das Örtliche, Das Telefonbuch and 11880 after the next directory update.
optout.notes: This is the German equivalent of going ex-directory. Das Örtliche says a person can object to all directories at once through the provider. Directories delete the entry once the provider sends the update, so timing depends on the provider.

sources.attribution: Das Örtliche Datenschutz on objection through the provider

verification_note: Das Örtliche privacy page and 11880 FAQ loaded with HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21 and both point to the phone provider.
